ideas.title: Two more for dinner. Same broiler.
ideas.targetAudience: Home cooks adapting a dinner recipe for more people and a dairy-free request.
ideas.whyWatch: Two extra places at dinner create a real capacity problem: more food, the same broiler space.
ideas.visibleEvent: Four settings become six; illustrative marinated pieces crowd a sheet, split across two sheets, and take turns under one heat source. Actual app settings move on a screen in the scene.
ideas.payoff: The recorded RecipeFix response adjusts the method to broil one sheet at a time and finish the chicken in sauce.
ideas.productBridge: Open Chicken Tikka Masala on RecipeFix and choose Make it fit.

variants.caption: Two more for dinner. The broiler did not grow. In this recorded RecipeFix dairy-free 4→6 example, the quantities change—and so does the method: two uncrowded foil-lined sheets, broiled one at a time, then finished in sauce. CGI planning illustration, not a cooked result. Try Make it fit at recipefix.app.

media.altText: Four dinner place settings become six. Orange stylized marinated pieces crowd a metal sheet. Actual RecipeFix settings change to Dairy-Free and six servings on a physical screen. The pieces split between two sheets which take turns in one illustrated broiler chamber; first-batch pieces move into sauce. Recipefix.app closes the film.

variants.caption: The headcount changed. The broiler space stayed the same. This recorded RecipeFix dairy-free 4→6 Chicken Tikka Masala response calls for two uncrowded sheets and one broiler batch at a time, then a sauce finish. CGI planning illustration; no cooked-result claim. Find Chicken Tikka Masala at recipefix.app → Make it fit.
